scope: Continuous page-turn latency follow-up to the preserved test audit; source/current candidate, not installed-client acceptance
changes: Stage the same SVG at unchanged native pixel dimensions through one detached 2D canvas before WebGL upload; release canvas backing and Image source in serialized capture finally.
Reuse oldest unpinned same-size RGBA texture only under budget pressure; pre-plan eviction, preserve current/pending faces, restore GL binding on success and errors.
Clamp settling interpolation to [0,1] to prevent rAF frame timestamps before release start from producing negative progress.
Strengthen existing E2E to 12 ordered pairs, exact predecessor IDs, full failure attachments, bounded GL allocation/RAF/long-task witnesses; add wide DPR3 double-spread regression.

root_cause.confirmed: Synchronous SVG Image conversion inside texImage2D/texSubImage2D blocked release frames. Same-storage reuse still reached62ms and a75.1ms queued gap. Canvas staging reduces the measured Chrome upload call to sub-ms without lowering pixel dimensions.
root_cause.mechanism_inference: Upstream image upload performs SVG draw/extraction; canvas upload can use bitmap/GPU copy. JS evidence does not prove a particular installed-engine internal branch or apportion CPU vs driver time.
root_cause.rejected_sufficiency: Allocation pressure alone was insufficient: reuse candidate sustained24 runs had3 latency failures at92.16MB. All failures and source snapshots remain.
root_cause.separate_confirmed_bug: Negative settling pose reproduced by E2E at -0.098322780874641 before clamp.
root_cause.unresolved_historical_observation: No-GL first-rAF delays of54.9–67.9ms occurred in earlier candidates. Exact scheduling cause remains unproven. Final instrumented24-run canvas sample has zero >50ms queued gaps and zero observed long tasks; this is not an absolute OS scheduling guarantee.

assessment.measured: Canvas staging changes raster RGB output at text antialiasing neighborhoods and inline-PNG interpolation boundaries. Alpha is byte-identical everywhere, uniform 3x3 interiors have zero changed pixels, all solid/position markers pass, and canvas allocation versus reuse is byte-identical at all DPRs. DPR 3 differences above 2 channel values occur only in the inline PNG region.
assessment.judgment: This fixture supports a minor rasterization/interpolation edge difference rather than missing glyphs, lost transparency, a whole-page color shift, cropping or resolution reduction. It is a real pixel-output change, so exact parity remains failed. It does not establish random GPU variation or prove the specific cause of the rounding/interpolation difference.
assessment.reportedVisualReview: The root agent reported intact glyphs/formula and localized antialiasing/PNG-edge differences in the DPR 3 baseline/candidate/diff images. This offline analysis did not perform an additional browser or visual run.

observedCaveats.sourceInference: The existing shadow plane emits alpha below one; gl.blendFunc(SRC_ALPHA, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA) also applies those factors to alpha. This explains the shape of the observation but was not isolated by a before/after render experiment.

findings: captureTail serializes each complete capture promise including finally, so only one scratch 2D canvas is active in JavaScript.

Owner, epoch, generation and aborted-scope checks occur after awaited assets and SVG load. No await occurs between the final validity check and staging/upload/cache publication, preventing route JavaScript from interleaving there.
Every path after scratch creation reaches finally, which resets both canvas dimensions to zero and clears the SVG Image source. Failure and optional-budget early-return paths share this cleanup.
Reused storage must have equal pixel dimensions and must be absent from both scene texture keys and pending required keys. Upload errors delete the failed texture and restore GL binding state.
invalidate aborts capture jobs and clears the cache; dispose also shrinks the main surface before context loss. Saved run02 verifies detached 0x0 old surface and no upload after route departure.

The new scratch is at most the existing per-leaf eight-million-pixel cap, about 32 MB raw RGBA in addition to texture cache and browser-owned buffers. This is a source-level bound, not measured native peak memory.
lifetimeReview.timingLimit: captureTrace.finishedAt precedes cache dataset publication and finally dimension reset. Queue/frame outcomes cover the eventual consequence, but this trace cannot separately quantify teardown latency.

remainingLimits: No physical trackpad gesture, installed application package or personal data path was exercised.
Text-only labels validate cached page identity; no PDF image, transparency, formula, scan fallback, chapter handoff or mixed-source cross-document range was visually accepted here.
Held images after eviction contain plain source text; the first page has inline glosses, but this set does not establish annotated held-text fidelity in every style/theme.
One current system WebKit build and actual DPR 2 display were observed. Other WebKit builds, DPR 3, double-page layout and device pressure remain outside this run.
Seven still PNGs cannot establish all animation frames, GPU presentation latency or subjective physical feel.
Native memory peak, OS texture reclamation and timing of scratch teardown are not directly measured.
The recorded shadow compositing caveat remains unresolved; content correctness is not full paper-lighting acceptance.
